newsitem.title: USA: CME March S&P 500s rise 15 points in active trade.
newsitem.headline: CME March S&P 500s rise 15 points in active trade.

text.p: CME March Standard & Poor 500 futures rose 15 points in active trade.

March continued to rally to 753.40, up 15.25 points, on expirations-related buying, traders said. December S&Ps expire at the close, while stock options and other index futures and options expire on Friday, December 20.
The late rally propelled March S&Ps above last Thursday's high at 752.50.
The next key level to the upside is at 755.00, traders said. ((Derivatives desk 312-408-8750;E-mail derivatives@reuters.com))
